requirements.text: The mobile app must provide real-time insights into customers' spending habits.
The mobile app must send instant notifications for every transaction, including amount, merchant name, and remaining balance.
The mobile app must notify customers when they are approaching or exceeding their personalized spending limits.
The mobile app must allow customers to set personalized monthly budgets for different spending categories.
The mobile app must provide ongoing tracking of spending in each category with visual representations.
The mobile app must incorporate alerts when customers are nearing their set budget limits.
The mobile app must provide automated monthly spending breakdowns categorized by merchant type.
The mobile app must implement biometric authentication for secure access, using both fingerprint and facial recognition.
The mobile app must allow customers to freeze and unfreeze their debit and credit cards directly within the app.
The mobile app must allow customers to set transaction limits and enable/disable international usage.
The mobile app must integrate smoothly with the existing core banking system via its current API layer.
The mobile app must comply with PSD2 regulations, particularly for Strong Customer Authentication.
Customer financial data must be stored and processed within the European Economic Area to comply with GDPR.
New credit or lending features must align with the Central Bank of Ireland’s consumer protection and responsible lending regulations.
The mobile app must maintain backwards compatibility with the existing app version for at least six months during the transition period.
